name: Marathon
source:
You play a long-distance runner who suddenly collapses during a marathon. While recovering in the hospital, you meet another patient, Ash, who keeps you company while you physically and mentally recover from your collapse.

[Edited from [url=https://marathone.itch.io/marathon]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你将扮演一名长跑运动员，在一场马拉松比赛途中突然体力不支昏倒在地。住院休养期间，你结识了同院病友阿什——在你身心双双从那场崩溃中慢慢恢复的日子里，他一直温柔地陪伴在你身旁。

[摘自[url=https://marathone.itch.io/marathon]itch.io[/url]（经编辑）]
